criteria.reason: Short sentences, simple vocabulary and clear structure suit an A2 reader; a few terms (opposition, conseiller juridique) are slightly above level.
States a 20-day objection deadline; the correct deadline is ten days from service, so this criterion is not met.
Gives clear, ordered steps (read, verify, contact a lawyer, keep evidence) and refers to legal and migrant-support help.

factual_errors: Says the objection deadline is generally 20 days; it is ten days from service (art. 81 LPD).
Says an official letter must be written; the objection can also be made orally, without giving reasons.
summary: Simple, well-structured help with sensible referral, but the response misstates the objection deadline as 20 days instead of ten and omits the oral objection option.
